blocks.raw: # Edit a Loyalty Promotion
blocks.text: Edit a Loyalty Promotion

blocks.raw: You can edit a loyalty promotion at any stage of its lifecycle. You may need to modify a promotion to update its rules, correct an error, or extend its duration. This action is typically performed by a maker, who can make changes to promotions in the draft state. Editing a live promotion is also possible; this action creates a separate, editable copy without disrupting the active promotion. Once a promotion has been stopped, it cannot be edited.

blocks.raw: To edit a loyalty promotion, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To edit a loyalty promotion, follow these steps:

blocks.raw:
1. In the promotion list view, navigate to the loyalty promotion to edit.

2. Select the **Edit** (pen) icon next to the promotion.

blocks.raw: ## Discard a draft
blocks.text: Discard a draft

blocks.raw: Discard a draft instead of sending it for approval if you no longer need it, for example if you started editing by mistake, or the live promotion changed after you created the draft.
blocks.text: Discard a draft instead of sending it for approval if you no longer need it, for example if you started editing by mistake, or the live promotion changed after you created the draft.

blocks.raw: The **Discard draft** button appears next to **Send for approval** and **Save and exit** whenever a pending draft exists for the promotion. Only a maker or admin can discard a draft; checkers and viewers don't have access to this button.
blocks.text: The Discard draft button appears next to Send for approval and Save and exit whenever a pending draft exists for the promotion. Only a maker or admin can discard a draft; checkers and viewers don't have access to this button.

blocks.raw: To discard a draft:
blocks.text: To discard a draft:

blocks.raw:
1. Open the live promotion from the promotions list view, which contains the draft.
2. Scroll to the end of the page and select **Discard draft**.
3. In the confirmation dialog, select **Discard draft** to confirm, or **Cancel** to keep the draft.

   ![](https://files.readme.io/fc585b730ef10308cf24c5d065536a8b08f0fb90a02fe444aa915816bb9cc9d5-Screen_Recording_2026-08-03_at_3.14.45_PM.gif)

blocks.raw: ### Stale draft errors
blocks.text: Stale draft errors

blocks.raw: If the live promotion changes after a draft was created from it (for example, someone edits the qualifying conditions on the live promotion directly), the draft becomes stale. **Send for approval** and **Save and exit** stay disabled on the stale draft until you discard it. Hovering over either disabled button shows this tooltip:
blocks.text: If the live promotion changes after a draft was created from it (for example, someone edits the qualifying conditions on the live promotion directly), the draft becomes stale. Send for approval and Save and exit stay disabled on the stale draft until you discard it. Hovering over either disabled button shows this tooltip:

blocks.raw: > The promotion has changed since the draft was submitted for approval. Discard this draft and create a new one based on the latest promotion details.
blocks.text: The promotion has changed since the draft was submitted for approval. Discard this draft and create a new one based on the latest promotion details.

blocks.raw: To resolve a stale draft, discard it and start a new edit from the current live promotion.
blocks.text: To resolve a stale draft, discard it and start a new edit from the current live promotion.

blocks.raw: ## Edit cycles in a live promotion
blocks.text: Edit cycles in a live promotion

blocks.raw: You can update a promotion's cycle schedule without disrupting members who are already in progress.
blocks.text: You can update a promotion's cycle schedule without disrupting members who are already in progress.

blocks.raw: ### Current cycle
blocks.text: Current cycle

blocks.raw: The table below lists what you can edit for the current cycle:
blocks.text: The table below lists what you can edit for the current cycle:

blocks.raw:
| Action                                     | Allowed? |
| ------------------------------------------ | -------- |
| Extend the end date                        | Yes      |
| Shorten the cycle or change the start date | No       |

rows: Shorten the cycle or change the start date
